name: Cookingdom
summary:
Welcome to Cookingdom, an ultimate chill & cozy game that makes cooking as relaxing as a satisfying Sunday morning. This is all about slowing down, having fun, and creating delicious dishes step by step. You’ll go from chopping potatoes to plating masterpieces, all while soaking in those soothing chill vibes. Let's explore the rich flavors of world cuisine with Cookingdom’s recipe book!

Each recipe is broken into small, satisfying mini-games that let you focus on one step at a time. Cooking feels better in a space you love, so customize your kitchen to match your vibes.
